facts.text: Refusal to issue a CCC for consent 71345; the remaining disputed items are B2 Durability and E2 External moisture; determination considers only whether there is sufficient evidence of compliance for those.
Dwelling on a level building platform on a 5,254 m² site; the previous owners applied and the current owners are parties.
Appendix A records invasive moisture-content readings taken by the building surveyor.
Decision: authority's refusal to issue the CCC on the remaining B2/E2 items is reversed (20 December 2022).
